config.decision_rule: Unit = one world (paired across planners). PRODUCTION beats a baseline on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI (4000 resamples) of the benefit (PRODUCTION better = positive) is > 0. I4 criteria: 'beats fixed views on actual hidden-state reconstruction' = hidden_state_error_improvement vs A-B1_fixed_inspection; 'beats random views' = the same vs A-B0_random; 'beats coverage-only' = the same vs A-B2_coverage; 'beats simple views on information/time/energy' = info_per_time AND info_per_kj vs each of those three; the closed-loop criterion = PRODUCTION's mean hidden_state_error_improvement > 0 with at least one accepted MCBR inspection goal that produced new target evidence in >= half of the worlds that needed one.
config.hypothesis: with the belief-side predictive model, the frozen production planner beats fixed, random and coverage views on the target's actual hidden-state error in the integrated mission
